content:
Samira A.: Kicking off a compact POC with Cedar Health. Need quick alignment on gates, owners, and handoffs. Customer expects a 3-week runway. Can we confirm who owns prompt evals, infra smoke, and the security checklist?
Kevin L.: I can own prompt/eval harness + baseline runs. Will need SE time: ~0.5 FTE wk1, 0.3 FTE wk2.
Jordan P.: I’ll coordinate SE coverage with Kevin. Sales-side ask: provide estimate for Dedicated vs Hosted for the trial (cost delta + fallback plan).
Samira A.: Thanks — customer will share a security questionnaire today (likely HIPAA-ish). Also asked for acceptance criteria: latency, quality, and cost envelope.
Kevin L.: Proposed success metrics: latency P50 < 300ms (99th should be < 1s for single-turn), intent accuracy >= 0.85 on their 200 prompt eval set, and token cost < $0.75 / 1k tokens (hosted) or equivalent for Dedicated.
Kevin L.: Suggest owners: prompt evals (Kevin), infra smoke & load (Jordan + SRE), security questionnaire (Olivia), pricing/contract (Samira).
Jordan P.: SE staffing: I can cover infra smoke + test harness on Mon/Wed slots. Need an SRE to validate KMS + VPC sim. @Olivia S. who should we loop from sec ops?
Olivia S.: Looping @security-ops and @compliance. Quick note: if PII/PHI is in test data, Dedicated or Private deployment recommended. For redacted data hosted is okay with our DLP/retention controls.
Olivia S.: Also attach: link to our standard questionnaire template: https://intra.redwood/pocts/sec-qna (customer copy-redact recommended).
Samira A.: Customer prefers hosted first for speed. Can we provide a hosted plan with a Dedicated fallback if data access issues appear? Also need a clear rollback/fallback plan.
Sean M.: We can provide a pinned model + automatic fallback policy. e.g., pin to `redwood-rlm-v1-quant` and fallback to `rlm-lite-compat` if capacity spikes. Ops will surface tracing for any fallback events.
Kevin L.: Draft POC week breakdown:
```
Week 0 (prep): NDA + Qs answered, data redaction guide.
Week 1: infra smoke, baseline eval, canonical prompt set created.
Week 2: prompt tuning, load test, integration with customer sandbox.
Week 3: user validation, acceptance testing, handoff doc + runbook.
```
Kevin L.: Need confirmation: who will run the acceptance eval with the customer? (SE + customer PM preferred).
Samira A.: Customer PM will run with SE. I'll arrange daily 30m standups M-W wk1 to keep momentum.
Jordan P.: Pricing ask: If they go hosted for 3 weeks and then Dedicated for pilot, estimate: hosted trial ~$9k (tokens + infra) and Dedicated reserve for a month ~$18k (depends on GPUs). I'll produce a ballpark slide.
Samira A.: Please keep the quote conservative — customer will want committed pricing if they move forward.
Olivia S.: Security gating checklist: encrypt-at-rest, KMS integration, audit logs enabled, service accounts scoped, redaction verification. If any testcases use PHI, mark as blocked until Private/Dedicated confirmed.
presales-bot: Quote generated: Q-2026-1123 (prelim). Pricing doc link: https://billing.redwood/quotes/Q-2026-1123
Kevin L.: Eval config (example) — will add to repo and share: 
```yaml
eval:
  name: cedar-checkout-intent
  prompts: prompts/cedar_checkout.jsonl
  metric: intent_accuracy
  threshold: 0.85
  budget_tokens: 200000
```
Jordan P.: Next actions: 1) Samira to collect customer security Q, 2) Olivia to mark gating items, 3) Kevin to push eval harness + baseline by EOD Tue, 4) Jordan to schedule infra smoke Wed AM.
Samira A.: I'll collect questionnaire today and set up the handoff doc. Standups start Mon 09:00 PT. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Olivia S.: A couple of quick blockers to flag: customer said they may include signed PDFs in prompts — need explicit redaction guidance and we should not accept raw PDFs into hosted instance.
Kevin L.: Noted — will add a preprocessing step to the harness to enforce redaction.
Samira A.: Great. If no objections I'll send customer the kickoff email with dates + owners in 1hr.
Jordan P.: :thumbsup:
